attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the given SSH public key and enforced key-based SSH authentication (PasswordAuthentication no, ChallengeResponseAuthentication no, PubkeyAuthentication yes, account password-locked). Verified sshd rejects password auth and accepts only pubkey/gssapi. Restarted node1 via native reboot, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified all configuration and opsadmin data persisted after restart.
